beliefs: f removes all Unicode whitespace characters (spaces, tabs, newlines, carriage returns, non-breaking spaces, em spaces, vertical tabs) from the input [E1, E2]
f preserves case, digits, and punctuation [E1]
Empty and all-whitespace strings map to the empty string [E1, E2]
notes: E2 shows tabs, newlines, CR, NBSP, em space, and vertical tab are all removed, not just ASCII space. Changed the rule to strip all Unicode whitespace via str.isspace().
